mapper.insert: insert into pev_event_log (type, pt_no, search_targets, search_from_date, search_to_date, pact_tp_cd, dept_type, dept_cd, stf_no, stf_nm, load_dtm) values (#{type}, #{ptNo}, #{searchTargets}, #{searchFromDate}, #{searchToDate}, #{pactTpCd}, #{deptType}, #{deptCd}, #{stfNo}, #{stfNm}, now())
mapper.select: select id as id, type as type, pt_no as ptNo, search_targets as searchTargets, search_from_date as searchFromDate, search_to_date as searchToDate, pact_tp_cd as pactTpCd, dept_type as deptType, dept_cd as deptCd, stf_no as stfNo, stf_nm as stfNm, to_char(load_dtm, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as loadDtm from pev_event_log order by load_dtm desc
select unnest(string_to_array(search_targets, ', ')) as searchTargets, count(*) as count from pev_event_log group by searchTargets order by count desc limit 10
